question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**moments**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage describes a sudden and catastrophic event: the ship striking an iceberg.
 
• The immediate consequence is "six great holes were made in the steel" and water rushing in. This implies a very rapid sequence of events.
 
• "**Moments**" (क्षण) best conveys the swiftness of the damage occurring after the impact, as it refers to a very brief period of time.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

Complete Passage: *The ship struck the iceberg (1) **with **__its side while it was still moving forward. In a few (2)__moments__, six great holes were made in the steel. Water rushed in, not in one place, but in separate places covering the Titanic hundred feet. The steel doors were therefore (3)_____ . Captain Smith soon understood that (4)______ could save the ship. He ordered the wireless officer to send out the ship’s position and the letters CQD, which is the call for help. It told the world that the Titanic was (5)_____.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "weeks"** – This implies a very long duration, completely contradicting the immediate nature of the disaster.
 
• **Option 2: "days"** – Similar to "weeks," "days" is too long a period for the holes to appear and water to rush in after an iceberg strike.
 
• **Option 4: "years"** – This is an absurdly long duration for the events described.
